imgDesc.text:
When
Anemo meets
Cryo, and certain other conditions are met, a special
Stellar Swirl reaction is triggered. This deals an instance of Anemo DMG to the opponent and generates a Stellar Vortex.
Triggering Stellar Swirl multiple times raises the level of the Stellar Vortex, which explodes after a certain time or after a certain number of Stellar Swirl reactions have been triggered. This deals AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents.
The aforementioned DMG can CRIT.

Up to one Stellar Vortex can exist on the field within a certain range.
A Stellar Vortex on the field will level up to Lv. 2 after a certain number of Stellar Swirl reactions have been triggered. A higher-level Vortex deals more AoE Cryo DMG to opponents over a wider area when it explodes.
After a Stellar Swirl reaction is triggered, certain nearby characters will also enter the
Radiance: Stellar Swirl effect for 8s, which enhances certain Talents and skill effects.
Certain characters can use their Talents to deal Stellar Swirl reaction DMG to opponents. This DMG can trigger CRIT Hits.
When the Stellar Vortex explodes, it will also grant nearby characters the ability to jump higher once, for a short time.
